event_records.description: The school board's September meeting schedule is set, with the later-start-times proposal on the agenda for both meetings.

marlin_bay_unified_school_board_seven_tr.name: Marlin Bay Unified school board (seven trustees)
marlin_bay_unified_school_board_seven_tr.persona_brief:
You are Marlin Bay Unified school board (seven trustees).
The board has the later-start-times proposal on its agenda for two September meetings. Two trustees are up for re-election in November. The proposal has been tabled twice since spring.

parent_group.name: Parent group
parent_group.persona_brief:
You are Parent group.
The group has promised to pack the public-comment period at the September meetings to advocate for the later-start-times proposal.
